title: Stage 1 realized research universe
derivation: produced by applying the eligibility rules sealed in config/stage1_universe_spec.json to the acquired data; no symbol was added, removed, or substituted by hand

survivorship_bias.honest_statement: The candidate list below was assembled in 2026 and therefore contains only funds that still exist in 2026. Exchange-traded funds that launched and later closed between the start of the development window and the data cutoff are absent from it. This is a real residual survivorship bias and it is not eliminated by the ETF narrowing.
survivorship_bias.binding_consequence: Every downstream result carries this limitation in its report. No Stage 1 artifact may claim the ETF universe is survivorship-free.

broker_eligibility.reason: No credential access is authorized at Stage 1.
broker_eligibility.binding_consequence: The realized universe is conditional. Any symbol later found non-tradable or non-fractionable at Alpaca must be removed and every affected gate re-run.

measurement_window_restriction.rule: No eligibility measurement may read validation-window or holdout-window data. This is a hard rule and is enforced by test, not by convention.
